from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx')
ws = wb['Budget']
print('Formulas in file:')
print('  C8  (Total Income)  :', ws['C8'].value)
print('  C23 (Total Expenses):', ws['C23'].value)
print('  C25 (Balance)       :', ws['C25'].value)
# Read expense values to compute expected total
expenses = [ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value for r in range(11, 23)]
print('Expense values (C11:C22):', expenses)
print('Sum of expense values   :', sum(v for v in expenses if v is not None))
incomes = [ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value for r in range(4, 8)]
print('Income values (C4:C7)   :', incomes)
print('Sum of income values    :', sum(incomes))
print('Expected balance        :', sum(incomes) - sum(v for v in expenses if v is not None))
"
